## Progress

- [PR #89](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/89): "Walk-in" on the board → find the patient (front-desk search) or quick-register (MDV-P1-015, guardian rule for minors from MDV-P1-020) and come back with the patient chosen → doctor or "next available" → one tap: `POST /v1/appointments/walk-in` books the earliest free slot from now today on the booking path (doctor-day lock, template and overlap re-check, SCHEDULE_SLOT rows, status + outbox + audit `appointment.walk_in` in one transaction), then the board's own check-in (same state machine, its own audited transaction, time recorded for exit gate 3); with no free slot it is queued under the chosen doctor as an unscheduled walk-in (zero length, no SCHEDULE_SLOT rows, not drawn on the schedule), so no slot is ever double-booked; cards tagged "Walk-in" in Checked in with the wait time; SQL Server tests incl. 6 parallel walk-ins for 2 free slots (2 distinct slots, 4 queued), mutation-checked; en/hi/ar, axe clean
- Left: the 60-second walk-in timed with a trained user at the pilot (the full flow runs in a few seconds in the browser checks)

## Description

"Walk-in" on the board: find or quick-register the patient, choose doctor (or "next available"), create an appointment in the next free slot or as an unscheduled walk-in, and check in immediately; card tagged Walk-in.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A walk-in can be registered (quick) and checked in in under 60 seconds.
- [ ] **AC2.** If no slot is free, the walk-in is queued without breaking the no-double-booking rule (unscheduled walk-ins do not occupy slots).
- [ ] **AC3.** Walk-ins appear in the Checked in column with wait time and the Walk-in tag.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
